name: Job Scout - Remote offers to Telegram

parameters.content:
## Job Scout
Every morning: pulls remote offers from 4 public job APIs, scores them against my profile (n8n / AI automation / AI training / video & motion / digital marketing), drops senior roles and offers restricted to other countries, removes offers already sent in the last 30 days, and sends the top 8 to Telegram.

Only public APIs are used (no scraping behind logins). Applying stays manual.
